views.label: Quarter
views.summary: Quarter-on-quarter overall SAP-AI sentiment down 0.27 pts to 2.59/5 — 6 topics softer, 3 firmer.

insights.title: vs. Competitors — +0.30 pts MoM
insights.body: Head-to-head coverage in 2026 puts SAP roughly level with Salesforce, Oracle and Microsoft in enterprise AI, but on different ground: SAP leads on transactional data depth and governance, and trails on speed, cost and openness. Its decision to force external AI agents through its own Joule assistant is the single most debated move of the year, read as either a smart grab for the data layer or a closed bet against interoperability. The evidence base is thin on named customer testimonials and hard adoption numbers, so this read leans on analyst and partner commentary rather than verified deployment metrics.
bullets: SAP now blocks third-party AI agents from its systems and routes them through Joule, while Salesforce embraces open Model Context Protocol interoperability (February 2026).
A consultancy comparison dated 2026 claims a client cut ERP costs 45 percent and closed books three times faster after moving from SAP to Microsoft Dynamics 365.

insights.title: Business Data Cloud — +0.21 pts MoM
insights.body: Business Data Cloud is landing well with the people it was built for: SAP shops trying to get ERP data into analytics without copying it endlessly, where reviewers score it 8.6 out of 10 on TrustRadius across 83 ratings and 4.2 out of 5 on G2 across 76 reviews. The Databricks link is real rather than slideware, with SAP's business meanings for tables and columns now syncing automatically into Databricks governance, but practitioners are blunt that the product loses its point when the main source system is not SAP, and they complain about cost, developer troubleshooting and clunky interfaces. Evidence here is drawn mostly from review-site summaries and vendor or consultancy commentary, with no named chief data officers, so this read is directional rather than definitive.
bullets: TrustRadius records 8.6 out of 10 across 83 ratings and G2 4.2 out of 5 across 76 reviews, with zero one- or two-star scores but a still-small base.
Reviewers credit zero-copy federation, meaning data is queried where it lives instead of duplicated, as the feature that finally attacks SAP data silos while keeping business context.

insights.title: SAP RPT1 — +0.20 pts MoM
insights.body: The pages show that RPT-1 is not a prompt-template or assistant framework at all: it is SAP-RPT, a "relational pretrained transformer" that predicts values in business tables, launched at TechEd Berlin in November 2025 and now shipping as versions 1.5 and 1.6 through SAP AI Core. Vendor and community material is enthusiastic about removing the need to train a separate model per forecasting task, and the only independent benchmark found, by a Microsoft practitioner in February 2026, says the open variant matches tuned XGBoost on small classification problems with zero training time but loses on regression and larger datasets. Genuine customer deployment stories are absent from these pages, so adoption reads as playground-and-pilot rather than production, and confidence in any satisfaction score is low.
bullets: SAP-RPT-1.6 reached general availability through the AI Core model library, with tabular orchestration and a playground API, indicating the product has moved past announcement stage (2026).
The first independent practitioner benchmark, published February 2026 by a Microsoft author, found RPT-1-OSS within 2 to 4 percent AUC-ROC of tuned XGBoost on small classification tasks.
